title: Refractor
description: A 1909 card reprinted on chrome and slipped into a penny sleeve. Tilt it and a diffraction grating splits the light into rainbow bands across the border and sky while the player stays matte ink; flick it and it spins with weight.
intent: One optical material finished to the edge: a real grating equation drives the rainbow, so the colour comes from the angle between the light, the foil grooves and your eye, masked from the printed photo by a chrome map generated from the card art itself.
